projectName: Beta Alpha Psi — Beta Tau Chapter
projectDescription: A full-stack web platform for the Beta Tau Chapter of Beta Alpha Psi at Arizona State University, providing member management, event tracking, announcements, sponsor relations, and a networking directory for students, alumni, and e-board members.
keyFeatures: Google OAuth authentication via Supabase with role-based access control (e-board, general-member, sponsor, alumni)
Event management with RSVP, geolocation-based check-in, attendance tracking, dress code, and calendar subscription
Member directory with fuzzy search, sorting, filtering by graduation year, major, status, and rank
Admin dashboard for managing members, sponsors, announcements, resources, and e-board positions
Sponsor portal with tiered sponsorship display (platinum/gold/silver/bronze) and resource uploads
Alumni and e-board networking pages with display email substitution support
Resource library with categorized firm and chapter resources, searchable by fuzzy text
Announcement system with pin support, audience targeting (all/members/pledges), and rich-text editing via TinyMCE
Member archive/restore flow with soft-delete and admin-controlled restoration
Planned migration from localStorage to HttpOnly cookie-based authentication for improved XSS security
publicApiSurface: GET /events — fetch all events (role-scoped response: MemberEvent | AdminEvent)
GET /events/:eventId — fetch single event with participant details
GET /announcements — list announcements sorted by pin status and date
GET /sponsors/ — list all sponsors with tier, photo, and metadata
POST /sponsors/delete-sponsor — remove a sponsor by name
POST /sponsors/:name/details — update sponsor about and links
POST /users — authenticate user and return role (e-board | general-member | sponsor)
GET /users/summary — list all users with email, name, role, rank
POST /users/delete-user — remove a user by email
GET /eboard — fetch e-board entries with role, display_email, name, major
GET /resources — list resource categories with signed URLs
GET /links?link_name=forms — fetch dynamic application form URL
